placeholders.name: SERVICE_PORT
placeholders.means: The TCP port clients must reach in this subnet

fixes.note: The network ACL then admits only the service port; add a numbered entry for each further service the subnet offers. Network ACLs are stateless, so replies leave on the clients' ephemeral ports (1024-65535); outbound connections the subnet opens itself need entries of their own. Nothing from the internet may then reach this group on any port; authorise each service the group must offer, from the sources that need it. AWS gives every security group an allow-all outbound rule; this narrows it to HTTPS. Add what the workload also needs outbound (DNS, NTP, updates) before you revoke the old rule.
